description: One extracted job posting record, as written to the SimplifyJobs database.

role_category.description: Primary functional category of the role.
role_category.title: Role Category

seniority.description: Seniority level. New grad, new college grad, early career, entry level, junior, associate, and level I or 1 roles are 'entry'.
seniority.title: Seniority

required_skills.description: Technology, language, framework, or tool names copied exactly as written in the posting, e.g. 'Python', 'SQL', 'AWS'. Empty list if the posting names none. No soft skills, no degrees, no full sentences.
required_skills.title: Required Skills

location_type.description: Work arrangement; null if the posting does not state it.
location_type.title: Location Type

company.description: Hiring company name as written; null if the text does not name it.
company.title: Company

salary_min.description: Minimum annual base salary in USD; null if no salary is stated.
salary_min.title: Salary Min

title: JobPosting
